[Review This Function](command:adviser.reviewFunction)
config.mode.description: When Adviser reviews code. Also switched by clicking Adviser in the status bar.
config.mode.enum.mentor: Mentor: reviews changed functions on its own on save, when you leave a function and after a 30 s pause. At most 20 reviews an hour.
config.mode.enum.reviewer: Reviewer: reviews on its own on save and when you leave a function, at most 6 times an hour. No steps: explanation and solution right away.
config.mode.enum.manual: Manual: only with the "Review This Function" command.
config.level.description: The learner's level: it decides what Adviser talks about and what it leaves out.
config.level.enum.beginner: Beginner: logic, edge cases, error handling, naming. No architecture or performance.
config.level.enum.intermediate: Intermediate: plus function structure, duplication and types. No large-scale architecture.
config.level.enum.advanced: Advanced: everything, including performance and architecture.
config.language.enum.auto: By the VS Code display language: Russian UI — advice in Russian, any other — in English.
config.solutionDelay.description: Pause before "Show solution". Does not apply to critical issues and the Reviewer mode.
config.solutionDelay.enum.auto: If you often open the solution right away (in 70% of cases over two weeks), "Show solution" appears a minute after the issue.
config.solutionDelay.enum.always: Always after a minute: try it yourself first.
config.solutionDelay.enum.off: The solution is available right away.
config.hiddenPatterns.markdownDescriptio: Mistake types (`patternId` from `patterns/patterns.json`) Adviser no longer talks about. Filled from the light bulb next to an issue: "stop showing".
config.budget.inputPricePerMillion.markd: Price of input tokens for your own key, $ per million — to track spending. 0 — do not count money (free and local models).
config.budget.outputPricePerMillion.mark: Price of output tokens, $ per million.
config.budget.dailyLimitUsd.markdownDesc: Daily spending limit, $. Once reached, reviews pause until tomorrow. 0 — no limit.
config.budget.fallbackModel.markdownDesc: When the limit is reached, review with this model on your computer (for example, `qwen2.5-coder:7b` in Ollama). Empty — reviews pause until the next day or month.
config.budget.fallbackBaseUrl.markdownDe: Address of the fallback model. Only a server on this computer (`localhost`): the fallback is free, and code does not leave the computer.
config.provider.description: Who reviews the code. Taken only from user settings, never from project settings.
config.provider.enum.openai-compatible: OpenRouter, Ollama (/v1), LM Studio and other OpenAI-compatible servers.
config.provider.enum.copilot: GitHub Copilot models through VS Code: no key needed, but you need Copilot (students can get it free through GitHub Education). Does not work in Cursor. adviser.model is the model family; empty — the first available one.
config.provider.enum.claude-code: Only for developing Adviser: a Claude subscription through the Claude Code CLI. Works only when run from sources (F5).
config.provider.enum.mock: Only for development and tests: a canned answer without a model.
config.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Address of the OpenAI-compatible server. For Ollama — `http://localhost:11434/v1`; in WSL and over SSH `localhost` points to another machine.
config.model.markdownDescription: Model. For OpenRouter — the model id, free ones end with `:free`. For `claude-code` the default is `sonnet`.
config.dev.prompt.markdownDescription: Development only: prompt version from `prompts/`, for example `mentor.v2`. Empty — the one in the extension. Works only when run from sources (F5).
config.dev.claudePath.description: Development only: path to the Claude Code CLI for the claude-code provider.
